paragraphs: Our company serves as an alternative investment vehicle for investors in the partnership who prefer owning our infrastructure operations through a corporate structure and we became a separately-traded public company upon completion of the special distribution in March 2020. In December 2024, the Arrangement was completed (see "History and Development of our Business — 2024 Developments" below for more details). Our company owns and operates high-quality, long-life assets that generate stable cash flows, require relatively minimal maintenance capital expenditures and, by virtue of barriers to entry or other characteristics, tend to appreciate in value over time. As of December 31, 2025, our operations consisted principally of the ownership and operation of regulated gas transmission systems in Brazil, regulated distribution operations in the U.K. and a global intermodal logistics operations. Upon Brookfield's recommendation and allocation of opportunities to our company, we intend to seek acquisition opportunities in other sectors with similar attributes and in which we can deploy our operations-oriented approach to create value.

Although our current operations are predominantly located in the U.K. and Brazil, shareholders have exposure to eight markets across utilities, transport, midstream, and data operating segments by virtue of the exchange feature of our company's exchangeable shares. The exchangeable shares of our company are structured with the intention of being economically equivalent to the units of the partnership. We believe economic equivalence is achieved through identical dividends and distributions on the exchangeable shares and the partnership's units and each exchangeable share being exchangeable at the option of the holder for one unit of the partnership at any time. Given the economic equivalence, we expect that the market price of the exchangeable shares will be significantly impacted by the market price of the partnership's units and the combined business performance of our company and Brookfield Infrastructure as a whole. In making an investment decision relating to our securities, investors should carefully consult the documents prepared by the partnership.

Our group's mission is to own and operate a globally diversified portfolio of high-quality infrastructure assets that will generate sustainable and growing distributions over the long-term for unitholders and shareholders. To accomplish this objective, our group will seek to leverage its operating segments to acquire infrastructure assets and actively manage them to extract additional value following our group's initial investment. As the business matures and cash flows have been de-risked, we seek to recycle capital and re-invest in assets that are expected to generate higher returns. An integral part of our group's strategy is to participate along with institutional investors in Brookfield-sponsored infrastructure funds that target acquisitions that suit our group's profile. Our group focuses on investments in which Brookfield has sufficient influence or control to deploy an operations-oriented approach.

Our group targets a total return of 12% to 15%+ per annum on the infrastructure assets that it owns, measured over the long term. Our group intends to generate this return from the in-place cash flows from our operations plus growth through investments in upgrades and expansions of our asset base, as well as acquisitions. The partnership determines its distributions based primarily on an assessment of our operating performance.

The partnership's distributions are underpinned by stable, highly regulated and contracted cash flows generated from operations. The partnership's objective is to pay a distribution that is sustainable on a long-term basis and has set its target payout ratio at 60-70% of the partnership's FFO. The partnership targets 5% to 9% annual distribution increase in light of growth it foresees in its operations.

On January 30, 2026, the board of directors of the general partner of the partnership approved a 6% increase in the partnership's quarterly distribution to $0.455 per unit (or $1.82 per unit annualized). Distributions have grown at a compound annual growth rate of 9% over the last 15 years.

Our board may declare dividends at its discretion. However, each of our exchangeable shares has been structured with the intention of providing an economic return equivalent to one unit of the partnership. It is expected that dividends on our exchangeable shares will be declared and paid at the same time and in the same amount as distributions are declared and paid on the units of the partnership. Accordingly, on January 30, 2026, our board approved a quarterly dividend of $0.455 per exchangeable share (or $1.82 per exchangeable share annualized), starting with the dividend to be paid in March 2026.

Currently, the Service Providers, each of which is an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of BAM, provide certain management, administrative and advisory services to Brookfield Infrastructure for a fee pursuant to the Master Services Agreement. Our company is also externally managed by the Service Providers. See Item 6.A "Directors and Senior Management — Our Master Services Agreement".

The SEC maintains an Internet site that contains reports, proxy and information statements, and other information relating to our company. The site is located at http://www.sec.gov. Similar information can also be found on our website at https://bip.brookfield.com/bipc. In addition to carefully considering the disclosure made in this document, shareholders are strongly encouraged to carefully review the partnership's periodic reporting. The partnership is required to file reports, including annual reports on Form 20-F, and other information with the SEC. The partnership's SEC filings are available to the public from the SEC's website noted above. Copies of documents that have been filed with the Canadian securities authorities can be obtained at www.sedarplus.ca. Information about the partnership, including its SEC filings, is also available on its website at https://bip.brookfield.com. The information found on, or accessible through, our website does not form part of this annual report on Form 20-F.

Our company was formed as a corporation established under the BCBCA and is a subsidiary of the partnership and Brookfield is our company's ultimate parent. See Item 4.C "Organizational Structure". We became a separately-traded public company upon completion of the special distribution in March 2020, as described below.

On March 30, 2020, the partnership contributed its U.K. regulated distribution operation and Brazilian regulated gas transmission operation to our company in exchange for loans receivable, exchangeable shares, class B shares and class C shares. On March 31, 2020, the partnership completed a special distribution whereby unitholders, as of record date March 20, 2020, received one exchangeable share for every nine units held (the "special distribution").

In December 2024, the Arrangement was completed (see "2024 Developments" below for more details), and the previous Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation entity was renamed to Brookfield Infrastructure Holdings Corporation ("BIHC") and the exchangeable shares of BIHC were delisted. The exchangeable shares of our company are listed on the New York Stock Exchange and the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol "BIPC". The registered head office of our company is 250 Vesey Street, New York, NY, 10281, United States. A subsidiary of the partnership owns all of the issued and outstanding class B shares which represent a 75% voting interest in our company and entitle the partnership to the residual value in our company after payment in full of the amount due to holders of exchangeable shares.
Holders of exchangeable shares hold an aggregate 25.0% voting interest in our company. Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation 59

On March 26, 2025, our global intermodal logistics operations sold its 33% interest in a stabilized container subsidiary for net proceeds of approximately $120 million. Upon disposition of its 33% interest in the subsidiary, our global intermodal logistics operation retained a 67% interest as an investment in associate.

Our group operates in a highly competitive market for acquisition opportunities.
Our group may be unable to complete acquisitions, dispositions and other transactions as planned.
Our group may acquire distressed companies and these acquisitions may subject our group to increased risks, including the incurrence of additional legal or other expenses.
Infrastructure assets may be subject to competition risk.
Investments in infrastructure projects prior to or during a construction or expansion phase are likely to be subject to increased risk.
All of our group's infrastructure operations may require substantial capital expenditures in the future.
Our group's operating subsidiaries are exposed to the risk of environmental damage.
Our group's operating subsidiaries are exposed to the risk of increasing environmental legislation and the broader impacts of climate change.
The lands used for our group's infrastructure assets may be subject to adverse claims or governmental or First Nations rights.

Some of our group's operating subsidiaries operate in jurisdictions with less developed legal systems and could experience potential difficulties in obtaining effective legal redress and create uncertainties.
Action taken by national, state or provincial governments, including nationalization or the imposition of new taxes, could materially impact the financial performance or value of our group's assets.
Our group's business relies on the use of technology, and as a result, our group may be exposed to cyber-security attacks.
Our group's operating subsidiaries depend on relevant contractual arrangements.
Our group relies on tolling and revenue collection systems.
Brookfield exercises substantial influence over our group and we are highly dependent on the Service Providers.
Brookfield has no obligation to source acquisition opportunities for our group and our group may not have access to all infrastructure acquisitions that Brookfield identifies.

Our group targets a total return of 12% to 15%+ per annum on the infrastructure assets that we own, measured over the long term. Our group intends to generate this return from the in-place cash flows from our operations plus growth through investments in upgrades and expansions of our asset base, as well as acquisitions. The partnership determines its distributions based primarily on an assessment of our operating performance.

Our company was established on October 3, 2024 by the partnership. The partnership owns and operates high quality, long-life assets that generate stable cash flows, require relatively minimal maintenance capital expenditures and, by virtue of barriers to entry and other characteristics, tend to appreciate in value over time. The partnership's current operations consist of utilities, transport, midstream and data businesses in North and South America, Europe and Asia Pacific. On December 24, 2024, the date of the Arrangement, our company acquired an interest in BIHC and consolidated BIHC in its financial statements. As a result of the Arrangement, (i) holders of the exchangeable shares of BIHC, other than Brookfield, received exchangeable shares of our company in exchange for their BIHC exchangeable shares on a one-for-one basis; (ii) Brookfield transferred their exchangeable shares of BIHC to our company in exchange for class A.2 exchangeable shares on a one-for-one basis; (iii) the exchangeable shares of BIHC were delisted; and (iv) the exchangeable shares of our company were listed on the NYSE and TSX. The partnership directly controlled BIHC prior to the Arrangement and continues to control our company subsequent to the Arrangement through ownership of the class B shares. As a result of this continuing common control, there is insufficient substance to justify a change in the measurement of our company. In accordance with our company's and the partnership's accounting policy, our company has reflected BIHC in its financial position and financial performance using BIHC's carrying values prior to the Arrangement.

To reflect this continuity of interests, these consolidated financial statements provide comparative information of our company for the periods prior to December 24, 2024, as previously reported by the BIHC. The economic and accounting impact of contractual relationships created or modified in conjunction with acquisition of interest in BIHC by our company have been reflected prospectively from the date of the Arrangement and have not been reflected in the results of operations or financial position of our company prior to December 24, 2024, as such items were in fact not created or modified prior thereto. Accordingly, the financial information for the periods prior to December 24, 2024 is presented based on the historical financial information of BIHC. For the period after December 24, 2024, the results are based on the actual results of our company, including the impact of contractual relationships created or modified in association with acquisition of interest in BIHC by our company. As the partnership held all of the class C shares of BIHC prior to December 24, 2024, which was the only class of shares presented as equity, and the partnership holds all of the class B shares of our company after December 24, 2024, which is the only class of shares presented as equity, net income and equity attributable to common equity have been allocated to the partnership prior to and after December 24, 2024.

Prior to the Arrangement, class C shares were classified as financial liabilities due to their cash redemption feature. As discussed in Note 1(c)(ii), Organization and Description of our Company, the class C shares met certain qualifying criteria and were presented as equity. Following the Arrangement and upon consolidation of BIHC into our company, the class C shares are presented as financial liabilities at fair value. As a result, the share capital pertaining to the class C shares was removed, and the difference between the fair value and carrying value of the class C shares was reflected as "Arrangement/reorganization" as shown in the consolidated statements of changes in equity.

For the periods prior to December 24, 2024, the financial statements represent those of BIHC, formerly Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation. During this period, all of the assets and liabilities presented were controlled by the partnership. Effective December 24, 2024, our company acquired an interest in BIHC and consolidated BIHC in its financial statements. The acquisition of interest in BIHC is a common control transaction where all transacting parties are subsidiaries of the partnership. As a result, the assets and liabilities of our company will be recorded at BIHC's historical carrying values in our company's consolidated financial statements. All intercompany balances, transactions, revenues and expenses within our company have been eliminated.

Our company incurs general corporate expenses according to the amended and restated master services agreement dated as of February 29, 2024, as amended from time to time, among the Service Recipients (as defined therein), BN, the Service Providers and others (the "Master Services Agreement"). The base management fee related to the services received under the Master Services Agreement has been recorded as part of general and administrative expenses in the consolidated financial statements.

Financial data provided has been prepared using accounting policies in accordance with IFRS Accounting Standards. All dollar references, unless otherwise stated, are in millions of United States dollars ("USD").

The partnership's distributions are underpinned by stable, highly regulated and contracted cash flows generated from operations. The partnership's objective is to pay a distribution that is sustainable on a long-term basis and has set its target payout ratio at 60-70% of the partnership's FFO.

The board of directors of the general partner of the partnership approved a 6% increase in the partnership's quarterly distribution to $0.455 per unit (or $1.82 per unit annualized), starting with the distribution paid in March 2026. This increase reflects the forecasted contribution from the partnership's recently commissioned capital projects, as well as, the expected cash yield on recent acquisitions. The partnership targets 5% to 9% annual distribution increase in light of growth it foresees in its operations.

Our board may declare dividends at its discretion. However, each of our exchangeable shares has been structured with the intention of providing an economic return equivalent to one unit of the partnership. It is expected that dividends on our exchangeable shares will be declared and paid at the same time and in the same amount as distributions are declared and paid on the units of the partnership. Accordingly, our board approved an equivalent quarterly dividend of $0.455 per exchangeable share (or $1.82 per exchangeable share annualized), starting with the dividend to be paid in March 2026.

Except as otherwise expressly provided in the notice of articles and articles of our company or as required by law, each holder of exchangeable shares is entitled to receive notice of, and to attend and vote at, all meetings of our shareholders. Each holder of exchangeable shares is entitled to cast one vote for each exchangeable share held at the record date for determination of shareholders entitled to vote on any matter. The holders of the class B shares are entitled to cast, in the aggregate, a number of votes equal to three times the number of votes attached to the exchangeable shares. Except as otherwise expressly provided in the articles of our company or as required by law, the holders of exchangeable shares and class B shares vote together and not as separate classes. Holders of exchangeable shares hold an aggregate 25% voting interest in our company.

paragraphs: 本公司為投資人提供替代性投資管道，使偏好透過公司結構擁有我們基礎設施業務的有限合夥人得以參與，並於2020年3月完成特別分紅後，本公司成為獨立交易的上市公司。2024年12月，交易完成（詳見下方"業務歷史與發展 — 2024年發展"部分）。本公司擁有並營運高品質、長壽命資產，可產生穩定現金流，維護成本相對較低，且因進入門檻或其它特性，資產價值有趨勢性成長。截至2025年12月31日，本公司業務主要為擁有並營運巴西的受規範天然氣輸送系統、英國的受規範配電業務，以及全球多式聯運物流業務。根據Brookfield的建議與機會分配，本公司有意尋求在其它具有相似特質的產業領域進行收購，並運用本公司以運營為導向的作法創造價值。

儘管本公司目前業務主要集中於英國與巴西，股東透過本公司可交換股份的交換特性，對電力、運輸、中游及數據運營等八大市場有投資敞口。本公司可交換股份的結構旨在經濟上等同於有限合夥人的單位。我們相信經濟等同性透過可交換股份與單位相同的股息與分紅，以及每張可交換股份可由持有人選擇隨時交換為一單位有限合夥人單位來實現。基於經濟等同性，我們預期可交換股份的市場價格將受到有限合夥人單位市場價格及本公司與Brookfield Infrastructure整體業務表現的顯著影響。投資人於評估本公司證券時，應謹慎參考有限合夥人所準備的文件。

本公司集團的使命為擁有並營運全球多元化、高品質的基礎設施資產，以長期產生可持續且成長的分紅，以對應單位持有人與股東。為達成此目標，本公司集團將運用其運營分部以取得基礎設施資產，並積極管理以提取更多價值。隨著業務成熟與現金流風險降低，本公司將重組資金並投資預期可產生更高回報的資產。本公司集團策略的重要部分為參與Brookfield主辦的基礎設施基金，以取得符合本公司集團特色的收購機會。本公司集團專注於Brookfield具足夠影響力或控制力的投資，以運用以運營為導向的作法。
本公司集團目標對其擁有的基礎設施資產，長期年化總回報為12%至15%以上。本公司集團意圖透過現有業務產生的現金流，以及透過資產基礎的升級與擴張投資，以及收購來實現此回報。有限合夥人根據對本公司運營表現的評估，來決定其分紅。
有限合夥人的分紅由穩定、高度規範且有約束力的現金流支撐，此現金流來自於運營活動。有限合夥人的目標為支付長期可持續的分紅，並已設定其目標支付比率為有限合夥人FFO的60-70%。有限合夥人預期其分紅年增率為5%至9%，基於其預期的業務成長。
2026年1月30日，有限合夥人一般合夥人董事會批准將有限合夥人季度分紅提高6%，至每單位0.455美元（或每年1.82美元）。過去15年，分紅以年複利9%的成長率成長。
本公司董事會可自行決定宣告股息。然而，每張本公司可交換股份的結構旨在提供與有限合夥人單位經濟回報相當的回報。預期本公司可交換股份的股息將與有限合夥人單位的分紅同時宣告並支付相同金額。因此，2026年1月30日，本公司董事會批准每季支付0.455美元的可交換股份股息（或每年1.82美元），自2026年3月支付的股息開始。
目前，服務提供者為BAM的間接全資子公司，根據主服務協議為Brookfield Infrastructure提供管理、行政及顧問服務，並收取費用。本公司亦由服務提供者進行外部管理。詳見第6.A項"董事與高階管理層 — 我們的主服務協議"。

證券交易委員會（SEC）維護一個網際網路網站，該網站包含有關本公司之報告、股東權益說明書與資訊聲明及其他資訊。該網站位於 http://www.sec.gov。類似資訊也可在本公司網站上找到，網址為 https://bip.brookfield.com/bipc。除了仔細審閱本文件中所披露的資訊外，股東被強烈建議仔細審閱合夥企業之定期報告。合夥企業有義務向證券交易委員會（SEC）提交報告，包括年度報告（Form 20-F）及其他資訊。合夥企業向證券交易委員會（SEC）提交之文件對公眾開放，可從上述網站取得。已向加拿大證券主管機關提交之文件副本可於 www.sedarplus.ca 取得。有關合夥企業之資訊，包括其向證券交易委員會（SEC）提交之文件，也可在該公司網站上找到，網址為 https://bip.brookfield.com。我們網站上或透過該網站取得之資訊，並非本年度報告（Form 20-F）之一部分。
本公司為依 BCBCA 成立之公司，為合夥企業之子公司，而 Brookfield 為本公司之最終母公司。請參閱第 4.C 項「組織架構」。我們於 2020 年 3 月完成特別分紅後，成為獨立上市之公開公司，如下列所述。
2020 年 3 月 30 日，合夥企業將其受英國監管之配送業務與受巴西監管之天然氣輸送業務，以貸款應收款、可轉換股份、B 級股份及 C 級股份為對價，轉讓予本公司。2020 年 3 月 31 日，合夥企業完成特別分紅，於記錄日 2020 年 3 月 20 日持有單位之單位持有人，每持有九單位可獲發一單位可轉換股份（「特別分紅」）。

2024 年 12 月，安排完成（請參閱下方「2024 年發展」以取得更多細節），先前之 Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation 企業已更名為 Brookfield Infrastructure Holdings Corporation（「BIHC」），並將 BIHC 之可轉換股份從市場除牌。本公司之可轉換股份於紐約證券交易所與多倫多證券交易所上市，代碼為「BIPC」。本公司之註冊總部為美國紐約市 250 Vesey Street, New York, NY, 10281。合夥企業之子公司持有本公司全部已發行及流通之 B 級股份，該股份代表本公司 75% 票據權益，並使合夥企業在支付完可轉換股份持有人應得金額後，享有本公司之殘餘價值。
可轉換股份持有人持有本公司總投票權益之 25.0%。Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation 59

paragraphs: 管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之分析（"MD&A"）

本公司之可轉換股權結構設計旨在經濟上等同於合夥企業之單位。我們認為經濟上等同是透過可轉換股權與合夥企業單位享有相同之股息與分派，且每一可轉換股權持有人可隨時選擇以一股合夥企業單位兌換可轉換股權。基於經濟上等同，我們預期可轉換股權之市價將受到合夥企業單位市價及本公司與Brookfield Infrastructure整體營運表現之顯著影響。除仔細審閱本文件所載之揭露資訊外，股東亦應謹慎審閱合夥企業之年度財務報告。合夥企業有義務向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交報告，包括年度財務報告（Form 20-F）及其他資訊。合夥企業向SEC提交之文件可於SEC網站（http://www.sec.gov）公開取得。已向加拿大證券主管機關提交之文件可於www.sedarplus.ca取得。本MD&A日期為2026年3月16日。
本公司集團目標為對所擁有之基礎建設資產，長期提供每年12%至15%以上的總回報率。本公司集團意圖透過現有營運現金流，加上透過資產基礎之升級與擴張投資以及收購來達成此回報率。合夥企業依主要基於對本公司營運表現之評估來決定其分派。

本公司於2024年10月3日由合夥企業設立。合夥企業擁有並營運高品質、長壽命之資產，產生穩定現金流，維護所需之資本支出相對較少，並因進入門檻及其他特質，資產價值往往隨時間推移而增值。合夥企業目前之營運包括北美與南美、歐洲及亞太地區之電力、運輸、中游與數據業務。於2024年12月24日，即安排日，本公司取得BIHC之權益並將BIHC納入其財務報表中合併。因安排之結果，(i) BIHC之可轉換股權持有人（除Brookfield外）以一對一方式換取本公司之可轉換股權；(ii) Brookfield以其BIHC之可轉換股權換取本公司之Class A.2可轉換股權，以一對一方式進行；(iii) BIHC之可轉換股權已從交易市場除牌；(iv) 本公司之可轉換股權已在紐約證券交易所（NYSE）及多倫多證券交易所（TSX）上市。於安排前，合夥企業直接控制BIHC，於安排後繼續透過擁有Class B股權控制本公司。因此持續之共同控制，無足夠實質理由改變本公司之計量方式。根據本公司與合夥企業之會計政策，本公司已於財務狀況與財務表現中以BIHC於安排前之攜帶價值反映BIHC。

為反映此持續之利益關係，這些合併財務報表提供本公司於2024年12月24日前之期間之比較資訊，如BIHC先前所報告。於取得BIHC權益後所產生或修改之契約關係之經濟與會計影響已自安排日起向前看方式反映，並未反映於本公司於2024年12月24日前之營運成果或財務狀況，因這些項目實際上在該日期前並未產生或修改。因此，2024年12月24日前之期間財務資訊係根據BIHC之歷史財務資訊呈現。2024年12月24日後之期間結果係根據本公司實際結果，包括取得BIHC權益所產生或修改之契約關係之影響。因合夥企業於2024年12月24日前持有BIHC所有Class C股權，此為唯一列示為權益之股類，且合夥企業於2024年12月24日後持有本公司所有Class B股權，此為唯一列示為權益之股類，因此2024年12月24日前及後之淨收入與權益歸屬於普通股之項目已分配予合夥企業。
於安排前，Class C股權因具現金贖回特質而被歸類為財務負債。如第1(c)(ii)節所述，本公司之組織與本公司說明，Class C股權符合某些資格標準，並被列示為權益。於安排後，並於BIHC納入本公司合併後，Class C股權被列示為以公允價值計價之財務負債。因此，Class C股權之股本項目已移除，且Class C股權之公允價值與攜帶價值之差額已列示為"安排/重組"，如合併權益變動表所示。

於2024年12月24日前之期間，財務報表代表BIHC，即原Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation。於此期間，所有列示之資產與負債均由合夥企業控制。自2024年12月24日起，本公司取得BIHC之權益並將BIHC納入其財務報表中合併。取得BIHC權益之交易為共同控制交易，所有交易方皆為合夥企業之子公司。因此，本公司之資產與負債將於本公司之合併財務報表中以BIHC之歷史攜帶價值列示。本公司內所有公司間之餘額、交易、收入與費用均已消除。
本公司依2024年2月29日簽訂之修正並重述之主服務協議（Master Services Agreement），如後續不時修正，與服務接受方（如協議所定）、BN、服務提供方及其他方之間之協議，產生一般公司費用。根據主服務協議所提供之服務之基本管理費用已列為合併財務報表中之一般及行政費用。
財務資料係依循 IFRS 會計準則編製。所有美元參考資料，除非另有說明，均以百萬美元（"USD"）為單位。
該合夥企業的分紅係基於穩定、高度管制且已約定的營運現金流。該合夥企業的目標係支付一項可持續的長期分紅，並已設定其目標 payout ratio 為合夥企業 FFO 的 60-70%。
該合夥企業之普通合夥人董事會批准將合夥企業之季度分紅提高 6%，至每單位 $0.455（或每年 $1.82 每單位），自 2026 年 3 月支付之分紅開始生效。此提高反映該合夥企業近期啟用之資本專案預期貢獻，以及近期收購預期產生之現金報酬。該合夥企業預期在考量其營運預期成長情況下，年度分紅增幅為 5% 至 9%。
本公司董事會可自行決定是否宣佈股息。然而，本公司可轉換股每張已設計為提供與一單位合夥企業相同之經濟回報。預期本公司可轉換股之股息將與合夥企業單位之分紅同時宣佈並支付相同金額。因此，本公司董事會批准等值之季度股息為每可轉換股 $0.455（或每年每可轉換股 $1.82），自 2026 年 3 月支付之股息開始生效。

除非本公司章程或法律另有明文規定，否則每張可轉換股持有人均有權接獲本公司股東大會會議通知，並得出席及投票。每張可轉換股持有人在股東名冊截止日所持有之可轉換股數，均有權對任何事項投票。B 類股持有人可 collectively 投票數量為可轉換股投票數量之三倍。除非本公司章程或法律另有明文規定，否則可轉換股持有人與 B 類股持有人應共同投票，而非作為獨立類別。可轉換股持有人持有本公司 25% 票據權益。

本公司之集團營運於一高度競爭之收購機會市場。
本公司之集團可能無法按計畫完成收購、處置及其他交易。
本公司之集團可能收購處於困境之公司，而這些收購可能使本公司之集團面臨增加之風險，包括產生額外之法律或其他費用。
基礎建設資產可能面臨競爭風險。
於建設或擴建階段前或期間對基礎建設專案之投資，可能面臨增加之風險。
本公司之集團所有基礎建設營運可能於未來需要大量之資本支出。
本公司之集團營運子公司可能面臨環境損害之風險。
本公司之集團營運子公司可能面臨環境法規趨嚴及氣候變遷更廣泛影響之風險。
本公司集團所使用之土地可能面臨不利聲請或政府或原住民權利之主張。
本公司集團部分營運子公司營運於法律制度尚未健全之司法管轄區，可能面臨無法取得有效法律救濟之潛在困難，並造成不確定性。
國家、州或省級政府所採取之行動，包括國有化或課徵新稅，可能對本公司集團之財務表現或資產價值造成重大影響。
本公司集團之業務依賴科技之運用，因此本公司集團可能面臨網路安全攻擊之風險。
本公司集團之營運子公司依賴相關契約安排。
本公司集團依賴收費及收入收取系統。
Brookfield 本公司對本公司集團具有重大影響力，且本公司集團高度依賴服務提供者。
Brookfield 本公司無義務為本公司集團尋找收購機會，且本公司集團可能無法取得 Brookfield 本公司所識別之所有基礎設施收購機會。

•與與其他市場參與者競爭相關之風險。
